flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx (compose-*/upload routes commented out), utils/Meta/AdhocNotification.ts (UPLOAD constants), components/field/FileField.tsx and utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts (generic). Folder pages/epic37/Uploads deleted. ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi: no message CSV upload endpoint
note: The story asks the officer to upload a CSV with mobile numbers/emails, subject and message, then auto-populate and display the fields. The upload routes (compose-email/upload, compose-sms/upload) are commented out (App.tsx:261-267) and pages/epic37/Uploads (Upload.tsx, useUpload.tsx) was deleted in commit 07aba128. What remains is generic: a csv format option in ValidFile.ts:123-125 and FileField, used by other uploads (e.g. bulk notice search), not a message CSV parser. No parsing of number/email/subject/message columns in the UI or backend. No relevant maintenance ticket (the bulk tickets are bulk create notice and bulk search, OCMS-DF-2026-187/188, not eNotification).
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Message CSV upload and auto-populate are not on main

steps.step: Officer chooses multiple and opens the CSV upload page
steps.detail: The compose-email/upload and compose-sms/upload routes are commented out (App.tsx:261-267); only constants remain in AdhocNotification.ts:47-56. Folder ocmsadminui/src/pages/epic37 (ComposeEmail, ComposeSMS, Upload, MessageSent) was deleted from main in commit 07aba128 (15 Apr 2025, git history, not evidence of running code); the Epic37 import at App.tsx:56 and the 6 compose/upload/message-sent routes at App.tsx:259-269 are now commented out, and the Compose Email/SMS/Message Sent menu entries at LinkData.tsx:143-156 are commented out too.

steps.step: Officer uploads a CSV with numbers or emails, subjects and messages
steps.detail: There is no message CSV upload control on main. The upload component and useUpload.tsx exist only in git history (commit 07aba128). The csv option in ValidFile.ts:123-125 is a generic file validator, not connected to this feature.

steps.step: The system reads and checks the CSV columns
steps.detail: No code parses number/email, subject or message columns from a CSV in the UI or backend (grep csv in ocmsadminapi: SmsUtil.sendBatchSms at SmsUtil.java:286 BUILDS an outgoing CSV for batch SMS via APIM and is only called by FurnishNotificationService.java:182 and :300, it does not read an officer-uploaded CSV; the rest is download/GetNotice/furnish attachment). No ad-hoc endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep adhoc/ad-hoc, compose, message-sent, enotification-send, scheduled send: zero hits in src; the only send-email/send-sms are in ManualReviewController.java:300 and :401, for furnish replies that require txnNo and noticeNo, not ad-hoc).

steps.step: The fields are filled in automatically from the file
steps.detail: There is no auto-populate; the RecipientForm/Recipients/MessageList components exist only in git history (commit 07aba128), not on main.

steps.step: The populated rows are shown on screen
steps.detail: There is no screen listing the uploaded messages on main. The recipient and message list used to be Epic37 MessageList (git history only).
